title: Obey All the Way
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The Lord gave Saul a job to do,
And said, "Do all I say."
But Saul kept back the finest sheep,
And did it just halfway.

[Chorus]
Obey the whole way through, my child,
Not just the easy part.
For God wants more than gifts from you,
He wants a willing heart.

[Verse 2]
Then Samuel heard the sheep go "baa,"
"What noise is this?" he said.
"To obey God is better than
The gifts you bring instead."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So when you're asked to do a thing,
Do all of it with love.
Now close your eyes, your day is done,
God watches from above.

[Chorus]
mood: Steadfast music. A firm, unhurried pulse in four walks under the voice, plain and honest, like a lesson spoken kindly but all the way through. The first verses keep an even, grounded sway with a touch of gentle humor when the sheep give Saul away. By the last verse the pulse slows and settles lower, the firmness softening into a tender, settled hush.
